The '''Orange Lady Tavern''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It had a private mooring dock attached, [[Dock 52]]. The Tavern was staffed by [[Erbus]], and one night was packed with customers who attended a performance by the [[Musician/Legends|singer]] [[Saahir Ru'luv]].<ref name="LAD" />
